title: Fire does last ...but it leaves a mess !
text: Fire does last ...but it leaves a mess !. You DO get a good enough fire if you follow directions ...take the wrapping OFF first, and crumple it under TWO logs ....and I'm thinking it IS environmentally cleaner. But it sure makes a heap of ash, and when you unwrap all the particles want to come loose. I'll try it a couple more times and see if I can get used to it some.
